hardwood-flooring/longboat-key.title: Hardwood Flooring Longboat Key FL | Wide-Plank Installers
hardwood-flooring/longboat-key.description: Hardwood flooring installers for Longboat Key's premium condo towers and villas in Bay Isles and Country Club Shores, with 2026 installed pricing.
hardwood-flooring/longboat-key.h1: Hardwood Flooring for Longboat Key Condos and Villas
hardwood-flooring/longboat-key.lede: On Longboat Key, almost every hardwood quote we write is for a condo renovation or a villa rebuild, not new construction, and the flood maps drive nearly every material decision before price ever comes up.
hardwood-flooring/longboat-key.capsule: Hardwood flooring on Longboat Key means engineered product almost exclusively, installed over concrete in Bay Isles, Country Club Shores and the island's mid-rise towers rather than nailed to a wood subfloor. Wide-plank European oak runs $14 to $19 per sq ft installed in 2026, standard 7-9 inch engineered $11 to $15, with solid hardwood reserved for the rare elevated single-family lot.
hardwood-flooring/longboat-key.body_html:
Almost every hardwood flooring quote we write on Longboat Key is for an engineered product going down over a concrete structural slab, not solid wood nailed to a wood subfloor, because the island's housing stock is mid-rise and low-rise condominium built mostly from the 1970s through the 2000s. Bay Isles alone covers close to nineteen distinct villa and condo sub-neighborhoods, and a unit in a building like L'Ambiance or Grand Bay sits on poured concrete from the third floor up, so the subfloor question is settled before we ever open a sample box. Ground-up new construction is rare here; most of what comes across our desk is a full renovation inside an existing tower or a teardown-rebuild on one of the island's remaining single-family lots.

Flood exposure shapes the rest of the decision. Nearly the whole island sits in an AE or VE flood zone on both the Gulf and bay sides, so a ground-floor unit is a poor candidate for solid hardwood regardless of budget, and we steer those jobs toward vinyl plank flooring or tile instead. Above the flood line, wide-plank European oak is the product homeowners in Country Club Shores and the Longboat Key Club area ask for by name, sometimes flown in specifically for a renovation, and a 1,400 sq ft mid-rise unit replacing carpet and old tile with wide-plank engineered oak would typically land in the higher end of our 2026 pricing given the island's material mix. Older villas from the 1980s that already have solid oak sometimes just need sand-and-refinish work rather than a full tear-out, especially where the existing planks were never exposed to a flood event.

Every job, new install or refinish, runs through an association architectural review first. Longboat Key boards want the manufacturer's underlayment spec and acoustic rating before they approve an engineered floating floor over a neighbor's ceiling, a step we walk through on the condo flooring page and with the condo flooring approval checklist. Our page on Longboat Key's condo mix breaks the island's neighborhoods down in more detail than we can here. Because so much of the island is a second-home or seasonal market, we also plan install timing around when an out-of-state owner can actually be on-site, a topic our post on solid versus engineered hardwood over a concrete slab covers in more depth.
hardwood-flooring/longboat-key.cost_html: Two representative Longboat Key jobs: a 900 sq ft condo living area redone in European white oak wide-plank at $14-$19 per sq ft installed runs $12,600-$17,100 in 2026, while the same footprint in the standard 7-9 inch engineered option at $11-$15 comes to $9,900-$13,500. A Country Club Shores villa with 700 sq ft of existing solid oak that just needs a sand-and-refinish, rather than replacement, runs $3,150-$4,900 at the $4.50-$7.00 per sq ft refinish rate. Removal of old flooring ahead of any of these jobs adds $1.75-$3.25 per sq ft.

faqs.q: Can I install solid hardwood flooring on the ground floor of a Longboat Key condo?
faqs.a: We generally advise against it. Nearly the entire island carries an AE or VE flood zone designation, and a ground-floor unit that takes on water during a storm surge event will need solid hardwood replaced outright, so we typically point those jobs toward waterproof vinyl plank or tile instead.

faqs.q: Does my Longboat Key HOA need to approve hardwood flooring before I install it?
faqs.a: Yes. Longboat Key associations typically require the manufacturer's IIC/STC lab report and a scheduled freight-elevator reservation before an engineered hardwood floor goes in over a neighbor's unit, which we cover on our condo flooring page.

faqs.q: Is solid or engineered hardwood better for a Longboat Key condo?
faqs.a: Engineered, in almost every case. Condo units here sit over a poured concrete slab rather than a wood subfloor, and engineered construction handles that surface and the association's sound requirements better than solid nail-down hardwood.
